translations.web: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, Yahweh; for our rebellions are many. We have sinned against you.
translations.bsb: Although our iniquities testify against us, O LORD, act for the sake of Your name. Indeed, our rebellions are many; we have sinned against You.
translations.kjv: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned
translations.asv: Though our iniquities testify against us, work thou for thy name's sake, O Jehovah; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
